issues.summary: Wet damage found on 14 cartons of diagnostic reagent kits at delivery of container OCLU6145131 (HBL MFCIM260017 / MBL OCLU260629), escalated as Severity 1 with expected claim over USD 10,000.

decisions.summary: Appoint an independent surveyor to inspect the 14 damaged cartons and establish cause and extent of damage.
Pursue the wet damage claim for HBL MFCIM260017 against the carrier Orient Container Line.
Send Seoul Medica Supplies a weekly update on the claim status until it is closed.
Jiwoo Han hands over the MFCIM260017 claim file to Daniel Cho as she leaves on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Send formal claim notice to Orient Container Line for 14 wet-damaged cartons in OCLU6145131 within 3 days of delivery, reserving all rights.
Arrange an independent surveyor to inspect the 14 damaged cartons.
Follow up on the pending survey report and take the claim forward with Orient Container Line.
Send weekly claim status updates to Insoo Hwang at Seoul Medica Supplies until the claim is closed.
Monitor the claim file for MFCIM260017 as team lead.
